testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.ui.screens.chat.ChatContentSheetsTest

testcase.name: a catalogue error is rendered inside the model sheet
a selected model outside the live list is named with a reload affordance
the model sheet renders provider, selection, and free badge
a loading session list says it is loading
a cached session list stays visible when the engine is unavailable
the handoff sheet prefills, selects a destination, and confirms with both
an empty session list says why it is empty
an unavailable session list does not claim the workspace is empty
picking a model dispatches SelectModel and closes the sheet
picking a session dispatches SelectSession and closes the sheet
the session sheet names the surface it belongs to and lists its rows
cancelling the trust dialog fires only dismiss
the trust dialog renders host copy and fires confirm exactly once
a refused confirm notice is rendered inside the handoff sheet
a model fetch in flight says it is loading
delete dispatches immediately with no confirmation
